subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should OpenCode and Pi history discovery ship enabled by default, including automatic OpenCode startup activation and paired-node catalog advertisement?
rationale: The linked issue is explicitly awaiting product direction, and the PR changes default discovery, startup, configuration, and session-visibility behavior for existing installations.

options.title: Approve default discovery
